name: Trapped With You
source:
You wake up in a cold, damp bunker with no recollection of how you got there. A man comes out of another room, claiming that it is the end of the world, and the two of you seek refuge inside a bunker. But something feels off. As you try to figure out what is going on, secrets uncover themselves. It's up to you to distinguish fact from fiction. 

[From [url=https://unknown-minnow.itch.io/trapped-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个寒冷潮湿的地堡中醒来，不记得自己是如何到达那里的。一个男人从另一个房间里出来，声称这是世界末日，你们两个在地堡里寻求庇护。但感觉有些不对劲。当你试图弄清楚到底发生了什么时，秘密就会自行揭开。由你来区分事实和虚构。

[来自[url=https://unknown-minnow.itch.io/trapped-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
